36833.name: PITAKA Iphone 18 Pro Edge Case (600D Black/Grey-Twill)

bullets.title: AEROSPACE-GRADE ARAMID STRENGTH
bullets.text: Light, yet remarkably strong woven from aerospace-grade aramid fiber, five times stronger yet lighter than steel. PITAKA's proprietary weaving process forms a precise geometric order. This classic texture returns to the essence of the material, delivering lasting durability and a refined tactile feel.

bullets.title: Premium Weave
bullets.text: Crafted from finely woven aramid fiber, our case offers a silky-smooth, luxurious texture you can feel. It's not just light and strong it's a pleasure to hold, every single time.

bullets.title: PitaTap™
bullets.text: A case under 1 mm thick shields the Camera Control Button with aramid fiber, while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. Seamlessly integrated, it preserves the aramid texture for precise, responsive control.

bullets.title: Paper Thin & Feather Light
bullets.text: Offers a sleek, barely-there profile that preserves your phone's original feel. Ideal for minimalists seeking elegant protection without added weight.

bullets.title: BE LIGHT, BE LIVELY
bullets.text: Recreating the first popular item of the Weaving+ series "Sunset Moment", we have woven an immersive blue time from sunset to moonrise. When we reflect on our life's journey, it's nothing but a collection of moments. Weaving+ Moment Series captures these enchanting moments using aramid fiber weaving, preserving fleeting experiences through countless experiments and explorations.
